# Operators

Edva uses Pratt parsing to resolve operator precedence and associativity.
The table below specifies all operator tiers, their Left Binding Power (LBP),
Right Binding Power (RBP), associativity, and semantic groupings.

## Precedence and binding power table

<!-- BEGIN operators.yaml -->
| Tier | LBP | RBP | Operators | Associativity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cycle | 10 | 20 | `@` `@@` `>--` `-->` `--^` | left |
| sequence | 20 | 30 | `;` | left |
| apply | 30 | 30 | `$` | right |
| feed | 40 | 50 | `$>` `$>>` | left |
| choice | 50 | 60 | `|` `[pattern]` `!|` `|->` `|+>` `|-->` `|++>` | left |
| assignment | 60 | 50 | `=` `:=` `+=` `::=` | right |
| range | 70 | 80 | `..` | left |
| logical or | 80 | 90 | `||` | left |
| logical and | 90 | 100 | `&&` | left |
| bitwise or | 100 | 105 | `.|.` | left |
| bitwise xor | 105 | 110 | `.^.` | left |
| bitwise and | 110 | 120 | `.&.` | left |
| comparison | 120 | 130 | `<` `>` `==` `!=` `!<` `!>` | left, same-line |
| shift | 130 | 140 | `.<.` `.>.` | left |
| addition | 140 | 150 | `+` `-` | left |
| multiplication | 150 | 160 | `*` `/` `%` | left |
| unary prefix | 160 | 180 | `!` `+` `&` `++` `.!.` `~~` `?` `??` `-x` `#size` | right |
| postfix / apply | 170 | 180 | `call ()` `.` `::` `: cast` `{N}` `@[...]` `!!` `--!` | left |
| primary | 180 | 180 | `primary` | left |

<!-- END operators.yaml -->

| Rule | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Left-associative tiers (`RBP > LBP`) | Operator binds tightly on the left (`a - b - c` $\equiv$ `(a - b) - c`) |
| Right-associative tiers (`RBP <= LBP`) | Operator extends rightward (`f $ g $ x` $\equiv$ `f(g(x))`) |
| Choice absorption (`$` / `$>`) | `$` (LBP 30) and `$>` (LBP 40) sit below `choice` (LBP 50), absorbing unparenthesized RHS choices (`a $> b | c | d` $\equiv$ `a $> (b | c | d)`) |
| Operator sections (`op rhs`) | Binary operators `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%`, `<`, `>`, `==`, `.<.`, `.>.`, `.&.`, `.^.`, `.|.` with a leading operand omitted form a 1-arg function over `_` (RBP 130). See [Operator sections](operator-sections.qmd) |

## Relational, equality, and chained comparisons

Comparisons sit at LBP 120, RBP 130 and return a bare flag `<>` (`<+>` or `<->`). Note that Edva writes greater-or-equal as `!<` ("not less") and less-or-equal as `!>` ("not greater"); `<=` and `>=` are not comparison operators (`=>` is function arrow).

| Operator | Meaning | Valid Operand Types | Floating-Point / Special Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<` | Less than | Numeric, `Rune`, `String`, `Addr` | Ordered (`OLT`); `<->` if either operand is `NaN`. Rejected on rams/enums (`E3127`) |
| `>` | Greater than | Numeric, `Rune`, `String`, `Addr` | Ordered (`OGT`); `<->` if either operand is `NaN`. Rejected on rams/enums (`E3127`) |
| `!<` | Greater than or equal ($\ge$) | Numeric, `Rune`, `String`, `Addr` | Ordered (`OGE`); `<->` if either operand is `NaN` (distinct from `!(a < b)`) |
| `!>` | Less than or equal ($\le$) | Numeric, `Rune`, `String`, `Addr` | Ordered (`OLE`); `<->` if either operand is `NaN` (distinct from `!(a > b)`) |
| `==` | Equal | Scalars, `String`, records, enums, `Type` | Deep structural equality on records and enums (`E3084` on non-enum rams or fn payloads); zero-alloc segment check on `str == (p1, p2, ...)` |
| `!=` | Not equal | Scalars, `String`, records, enums, `Type` | Logical negation of `==` (`UNE` on floats: `<+>` if either operand is `NaN`) |

### Chained comparisons

Relational operators (`<`, `>`, `!<`, `!>`) on the **same source line** chain mathematically:

| Chained Expression | Equivalent Short-Circuit Evaluation | Middle Operand Evaluation |
|---|---|---|
| `a < x < b` | `t = x; (a < t) && (t < b)` | Evaluated **at most once** |
| `a !> x < b` | `t = x; (a !> t) && (t < b)` | Evaluated **at most once** |
| `a !> x !> b` | `t = x; (a !> t) && (t !> b)` | Evaluated **at most once** |
| `b > f(x) > a` | `t = f(x); (b > t) && (t > a)` | `f(x)` called **at most once** (only if needed) |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

in_half_open: Int, Int, Int => <>
in_half_open = x, lo, hi => lo !> x < hi

io::out $ in_half_open(5, 0, 10)   // <+>
io::out $ in_half_open(10, 0, 10)  // <->
```

## Range operators (`..`, `...`, `..=`)

Range operators sit at LBP 70, RBP 80. Endpoints must be adjacent to the operator without whitespace (`E2025`). Ranges are consumed by choice guards `[...]`, cycles `@`, and slice/substring calls `x(...)` (see [Expressions — Range expressions](expressions.qmd#range-expressions-..-..)):

| Operator | Interval Kind | Math Notation | Lower Bound `a` | Upper Bound `b` | Choice Guard `[...]` | Cycle `@` | Slice / View `x(...)` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a..b` | Half-open (left-closed, right-open) | $[a, b)$ | Closed ($a \le x$) | Open ($x < b$) | `a !> x < b` | `a` through `b - 1` | Elements `[a, b)` |
| `a...b` / `a..=b` | Closed (both inclusive) | $[a, b]$ | Closed ($a \le x$) | Closed ($x \le b$) | `a !> x !> b` | `a` through `b` | Elements `[a, b]` |
| `a..` | Lower-bounded closed | $[a, \infty)$ | Closed ($a \le x$) | Unbounded | `x !< a` | Unbounded from `a` | From `a` to `?x` (`-k..` from `?x - k`) |
| `..b` | Upper-bounded open | $(-\infty, b)$ | Unbounded | Open ($x < b$) | `x < b` | `0` through `b - 1` | Elements `[0, b)` |
| `...b` / `..=b` | Upper-bounded closed | $(-\infty, b]$ | Unbounded | Closed ($x \le b$) | `x !> b` | `0` through `b` | Elements `[0, b]` |
| `..` | Unbounded | $(-\infty, \infty)$ | Unbounded | Unbounded | `<+>` | Unbounded from `0` | Full view `[0, ?x)` |

## Arithmetic, bitwise, shift, and logical operators

| Category | Operators | Operand Types | Result Type & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Arithmetic | `+` `-` `*` `/` `%` | Numeric (`Int`, `Float`, `i8`..`u64`, `f32`, SIMD vectors) | Same numeric type (`+` also concatenates `String` and `Rune`) |
| Bitwise | `.|.` `.^.` `.&.` `.!.` | Integerish (`Int`, `i8`..`u64`, integer SIMD vectors) | Same integer type (`.!.` is unary bitwise NOT) |
| Bit shift | `.<.` `.>.` | Integerish | Left shift (`.<.`) and zero-fill/logical or signed right shift (`.>.`); sections infer `Int => Int` |
| Logical | `&&` `||` | `<>` (Flag) or compatible heap ramifications | Short-circuiting AND / OR |
| Map access | `m ^ k`<br>`m ^? k`<br>`m ^- k` | Map `K ^ V`, key `K` | `^`: `< V | >` lookup (`m ^ k = v` inserts)<br>`^?`: `<>` key existence check<br>`^-`: `<>` key removal |

## Type-directed and postfix operators

| Form | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `!flag` | Flag negation (`<>` only; emits `E3008` on other types) |
| `+builder` | Freeze a `Builder` into an immutable `String` in-place (no space after `+`) |
| `&buffer` / `&string` | Adjacent unary buffer/data address (`Addr`) for FFI (no space after `&`) |
| `?value` | Byte, element, entry, field, or variant count (`?s`, `?b`, `?a`, `?m`, `?T`) |
| `??string` | UTF-8 Unicode codepoint count |
| `++value` | Deep arena copy of `String`, `Builder`, record, slice, or growable array |
| `result!!` | Unwrap positive ram payload or abort |
| `result--!` | Unwrap positive ram payload or early-return negative ram from enclosing function |
| `~~lvalue` | Two-way state binding lens record `(get = !=> ..., set = v => ...)` |
| `expr {N}` | Repeat `expr` `N` times into a homogeneous record `(T * N)` |
| `@[addr T]` | Volatile typed memory load (`@[addr] = val` for store; `@[addr T] = val` is an error) |
| `#size Type` | Compile-time byte size of `Type` |
